title: A non-terminal Engram error envelope carries no control-process evidence although the worker holds the live process
outcome: A request-level status:error envelope (EngramTransportError::remote, which keeps the control process alive), such as control_unavailable or store_corrupt, records the control process's identity and observed state on its causal failure, and does not report them as unavailable. A process-fixture test covers a non-terminal error envelope.
acceptance: A non-terminal Engram error envelope carries no control-process evidence although the worker holds the live process is done
